guide: 📖 Advertisement Guide 📢 An active Premium subscription is required to use the advertising service. 📝 When creating an advertisement, you can add a title, description, and an optional image. ⏳ Newly created advertisements are saved with the Pending status and are not shown to users. ▶️ You can activate your advertisement at any time from the My Advertisements section. 🟢 You can have a maximum of 2 active advertisements at the same time. 📅 Once activated, an advertisement will be shown to users for 5 days, after which it will automatically move to the Expired status. 📊 You can monitor views, clicks, and performance statistics for each advertisement.
